title: AgentCARD cross-benchmark prompt-scaffold control on standard MCP-ATLAS free-60

execution.stopping_rule: exactly 60 tasks per arm and all four arms; no extension based on observed outcomes

evaluation.online_evaluation: deferred; raw answers and trajectories only
evaluation.judge_requirement: No MCP-60 accuracy is reportable until the frozen judge is available and all 240 responses are judged under the same endpoint/configuration.

known_environment_constraint.policy: Keep both tasks in all four arms and in the denominator. Tool unavailability is disclosed; no replacement tasks are selected.

analysis.primary: Within each scaffold, paired gpt-5.4-planner minus gpt-5.4-executor comparison on all 60 task IDs.
analysis.cross_benchmark: Report FinanceBench and MCP-ATLAS separately; no pooled accuracy and no benchmark selection after results.
analysis.failure_policy: Agent or tool failures score zero. Any model-endpoint auth/5xx/timeout or MCP-server outage makes the complete four-arm matrix infrastructure-invalid; partial arms are retained as an incident and not used for comparison.
analysis.reporting_rule: Report every frozen arm and both benchmarks, including null or unfavorable outcomes.
